scope: Crop nutrition, soil fertility, agronomic calculators, technical assistance, and continuing education

records.name: Nutrien eKonomics Soil Fertility Information Resource
records.description: Free crop-nutrition and soil-fertility platform offering Ask an Agronomist technical assistance, research summaries, podcasts, crop guides, agronomic toolkits, nutrient-balance analysis, webinars, continuing-education opportunities, and calculators for yield return, growing degree days, rainfall, nutrient removal, fertilizer planning, application rates, acreage, and input planning.
records.availability_notes: eKonomics is operated by Nutrien, a commercial crop-input and fertilizer company. Its educational materials, calculators, and free agronomist support can be useful, but product-related assumptions and recommendations should be compared with independent Extension, soil-test, conservation, and locally appropriate agronomic guidance. Tool inputs, datasets, research summaries, webinars, and continuing-education availability may change. The tracking parameters from the submitted advertising URL were removed. Verified August 6, 2026.
